text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall despite a small monthly decline, so I should judge decisions over time rather than react to one period.","Selling Stock E after a large gain may have felt prudent, but its past gain alone does not tell me what it will do next; I should base trades on my plan, not my average cost or recent returns.","Because prices move randomly and losses weigh heavily on me, I should manage risk through diversification and deliberate position sizing rather than frequent reactive trades."]}
